## Changes since `v0.7.2-beta.9`

### Features

- search the saved connections a jump host logs in as: a hop's Connect as list was a plain select of every saved connection, hard to scan once there are many; it now opens a searchable list that finds a connection by its name, group, host or user, grouped as before, and a hop whose saved connection was deleted still says so on the button ([96b70f52](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/96b70f52cef9e67f73ad1360447d21083575c6ce))
- start local shells on macOS with shell integration by default: local bash, zsh and fish on macOS marked their commands only once the switch was turned on, so finished-command notifications and jumping between commands needed a trip to Settings first; the switch is now on by default on macOS and stays off on Linux, so it no longer travels with sync and moves to a new key, as every saved config holds the old one as off; an older config or backup that turned it on keeps it on, and one that left it off gets this device's default ([67d5e6eb](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/67d5e6eb09f4527cc6db7e49475cb70a183c5f10))
- start SSH sessions with shell integration by default: a connection had it only when its checkbox was ticked, so most never marked commands or let the SFTP panel follow the shell; a setting under Settings › Connection now turns it on for every connection, on by default, and each connection follows it, turns it on or turns it off; a host with another shell, no POSIX sh or an unwritable cache still gets a plain shell, and only a connection that turned it on itself is told so in a toast, so a router or a Windows server doesn't raise one on every connect; profiles, backups, sync files and restored tabs from before keep a ticked checkbox as on and read an unticked one as following the setting, so the stored choice moves to a new key that older versions ignore ([41a2d056](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/41a2d05697a27a69b1a4dfefe77d3dabab915dc6))

### Fixes

- give a searchable list's options ids without spaces: an option's element id held its group's heading, so a heading with a space, such as Preset themes, made an id that aria-activedescendant cannot point at, and a screen reader lost the highlighted option; the ids now go by position in the list ([8dba08ab](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/8dba08ab4a71f67205556a5b0664e1cd43539f24))

### UI and usability

- show a grip on a pane divider while it is hovered or dragged: the thin line in the gap between panes, hidden in the islands style, gave little sign it could be dragged, so a short rounded grip now shows in its middle on hover and stays while it is dragged; it stays hidden otherwise, so a grid of panes isn't dotted with grips, and the divider being dragged is marked by a class rather than by hover, which WebKit may drop under pointer capture ([da9d12d8](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/da9d12d8432a149f2aecce24a99292f04464f615))
- frame the pane with the keyboard whether or not panes show headers: with headers, only the header's small tab marked it, which takes a search in a grid of panes, so the accent frame drawn without headers now shows with them too, fainter as the header marks it as well; while another app has the keyboard the frame fades, since no pane has it then, but stays faintly to show where typing goes on coming back ([e246dbe2](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/e246dbe25d019e7ef85e2be9aeb71c5af53070a1))
